study_pi: Navin, Nicholas; Kessenbrock, Kai; Lawson, Devon A
comments: Reassembled from CxG deposit for iHBCA v1.0; contralateral/reduction/prophylactic tissue only, tumor samples excluded from atlas. Mixed 10x chemistries (v2/v3/v3.1) across samples; v3.1 collapsed to EFO:0009922 per CxG convention. Mixed sequencing platforms across samples.
description: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic atlas of 714,331 cells from 126 women identifying 12 major cell types and 58 cell states across epithelial, immune, stromal, and vascular compartments.
